base_analysis.subject_identity_requirements: Do not reuse reference person identity; create new founder identity with no recognizable borrowing from source subject.

observations.description: Centered female subject with direct camera gaze and warm smile.
White tailored blazer over white top, double gold choker necklace, ring on left hand.
Hands clasped in front at waist level, composed stance.
Warm directional key light from upper left modeling face and shoulder with soft highlight.
Rim or back light creating subject separation and edge glow.
Dark background with out-of-focus secondary figure and visible flag imagery.
Abstract golden curved shapes floating in background.
Halftone dot pattern on left side of frame.
Shallow depth of field with background planes blurred.
Warm gold and white color palette with dark brown or black anchors.
Medium shot crop at waist, centered composition.
Reflective surface below subject creating mirror reflection.

reference_dna.primary: Centered authority with warm approachability through direct gaze and composed stance
reference_dna.secondary: Warm directional lighting with rim separation creating editorial focus
reference_dna.supporting: Material precision in accessories, abstract background depth, shallow depth isolation
reference_dna.incidental: Specific political symbols, exact fashion wardrobe, recognizable person identity

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Climate-tech founder with direct camera gaze and composed stance; adapt gesture to feel innovative and approachable rather than formal.
design_decision_map.rationale: Direct gaze creates trust and human connection essential for founder credibility. Composed stance communicates confidence. Adapt specific gesture to match climate-tech innovation energy while maintaining approachability.
protected_dependencies: target communication goal: credibility with warmth

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Warm directional key light with rim separation; shift color palette from gold to climate-tech appropriate accents (warm amber, soft green, or clean cool-warm mix) while maintaining dark anchors.
design_decision_map.rationale: Warm key light creates optimism and human warmth; rim light provides authority and focus. Color must shift from fashion-luxury gold to climate-tech brand territory while preserving the warm, optimistic tone.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Tailored jacket in sustainable fabric (organic cotton, linen, recycled polyester) in neutral tone; replace gold choker with minimal precision metal (titanium, recycled aluminum) or technical pendant.
design_decision_map.rationale: White fashion blazer and gold jewelry signal celebrity/fashion luxury. Must translate to climate-tech professional authority through sustainable materials and precision technical accessories that communicate innovation and responsibility.

cross_category_adaptation.equivalent_adaptation: Tailored jacket in sustainable fabric (organic cotton, linen, recycled polyester) in neutral tone; minimal precision metal accessory (titanium, recycled aluminum) or technical pendant
cross_category_adaptation.target_category_coherence: Sustainable fabrics and precision metals signal innovation, responsibility, and technical competence appropriate for climate-tech founder; avoids fashion-luxury association that conflicts with target context.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Abstract climate-tech environment with layered depth: renewable energy infrastructure, lab equipment, urban green space, or data visualization layers. Maintain shallow depth of field for subject isolation.
design_decision_map.rationale: Background provides narrative context and depth. Must replace political symbols and fashion-editorial background with climate-tech specific environment that communicates innovation and environmental mission.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Maintain centered composition and medium shot crop for editorial clarity, optimized for 4:5 portrait format.
design_decision_map.rationale: Centered composition creates stability, clarity, and monumentality appropriate for founder profile. Medium shot provides enough context while keeping subject dominant.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Remove literal reflection or replace with climate-tech appropriate reflective surface (polished concrete, glass, water feature) if depth enhancement is needed.
design_decision_map.rationale: Current reflection is generic and adds no climate-tech narrative value. If depth is needed, use target-native reflective surface that supports the innovation context.

risks.description: Identity leakage: Reference subject is recognizable public figure; target must not borrow facial features, styling cues, or identity markers.
risks.mitigation: Complete subject replacement with new person; audit all styling, hair, and makeup decisions against reference to ensure no recognizable borrowing.

risks.description: Political symbol contamination: Israeli flag and associated imagery in reference background must not transfer.
risks.mitigation: Complete background replacement; no symbolic, color, or pattern carryover from political/religious imagery.

risks.description: Fashion-luxury mismatch: White blazer and gold jewelry signal fashion/celebrity rather than climate-tech innovation.
risks.mitigation: Translate wardrobe to sustainable tailoring and accessories to precision technical materials; avoid any fashion-editorial styling cues.

risks.description: Generic warm palette: Over-transfer of gold/warm tones could feel like generic warm professional without climate-tech specificity.
risks.mitigation: Introduce climate-tech specific color accents (verified green, blue, or amber) while maintaining warm light temperature; ensure palette feels owned by target brand.

provenance.notes: Reference reinterpretation for climate-tech founder. Identity and political symbols excluded. Fashion-luxury elements adapted to climate-tech professional context.

confidence.rationale: Reference provides strong editorial portrait mechanisms (lighting, composition, gaze, depth) that transfer well to target. Main challenges are identity protection and category translation, which are manageable through adaptation and reinvention.
